sources.document: Caracteristicas geodinamicas en el distrito de Paita (Provincia de Paita - Region Piura), Informe Tecnico N. 032-2021/IGP

notes: pages 8-9 identify Nueva Esperanza, La Piscina, Catarata and Villa Naval as tributary ravines whose waters finally drain through the principal ravine El Zanjon to the Pacific Ocean
page 17 documents activation context for Quebrada Catarata and lower-area exposure
page 20 states El Zanjon is the principal ravine receiving secondary ravines

admissible_claims: Nueva Esperanza, La Piscina, Catarata and Villa Naval are distinct named ravines in Paita
IGP reports a system-level drainage topology in which those secondary ravines feed the principal ravine El Zanjon
IGP reports the El Zanjon system ultimately discharging to the Pacific Ocean
IGP documents field-based geodynamic inspection and activation context during rainy periods
IGP specifically documents Quebrada Catarata activation context producing mudflows that affect lower-area housing
forbidden_inferences: the report figures may be digitized directly as reproducible child catchment geometry without a frozen georeferencing method
the narrative topology provides exact confluence coordinates or current engineered routing
rainy-period activation language is a dated event ledger for every child
the report wording about storage or overflow defines a numerical hydraulic capacity
all named ravines share one activation state
the Pacific receiver relationship supplies an exact shoreline outlet coordinate

sources.document: Zonificacion sismica-geotecnica de la ciudad de Paita
admissible_claims: the official IGP study is admissible as supporting identity/context for the named Paita ravines already registered in IRFEN
the study may support urban geodynamic context without collapsing distinct ravines into one hydrologic unit
forbidden_inferences: geotechnical zoning is an observed flood footprint
a hazard class is an IRFEN activation state or threshold
the study supplies exact child outlets unless coordinates are independently frozen and QA checked

admissible_claims: the municipal/CENEPRED record supports El Zanjon as a distinct ravine with historical urban inundation/overflow context
forbidden_inferences: historical overflow context transfers activation to Nueva Esperanza, La Piscina, Catarata or Villa Naval
risk zoning is an exact observed event footprint
